simple: Network traffic analysis (NDR): a Virtual Network Sensor, a sensor on TippingPoint appliances or Deep Discovery Inspector monitors traffic, including decrypted traffic, and spots command-and-control channels, lateral movement, suspicious file transfers and devices without agents — IoT, printers, personal devices. Shows the attack timeline, correlates network events with endpoint and cloud data and keeps events for six months or more. Suspicious files can be sent to a sandbox automatically (extra cost). Licensed by throughput (in steps of 500 Mbps). Part of the TrendAI Vision One platform (Trend Micro’s business unit, formerly Trend Vision One); licensed with TrendAI Flex credits that can be reallocated across platform solutions.
